Write a rendered stimulus to disk

Source: R/stims-helpers.R
write_stimulus.Rd

A thin wrapper of magick::image_write() function.

Usage

write_stimulus(image, path, ...)

Arguments

image

A magick image object.

path

Output file path.

...

Additional parameters passed to magick::image_write().

Value

Invisibly returns path.

See also

Other stimuli: catlas_stimulus(), print.catlas_stimulus(), render_stimulus(), render_stimulus.catlas_stimulus()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# A minimal white PNG to satisfy the file-existence check
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
magick::image_write(magick::image_blank(1L, 1L, "white"), tmp)

stim <- catlas_stimulus(
  label      = "Xyline",
  image_path = tmp,
  type       = "cue"
)
print(stim)
write_stimulus(img, "output.png")
} # }
